tablet.image.empty: Enter a URL to show an image here
tablet.image.error.untrusted: To see images from this site, turn on "Allow Untrusted URLs" in VRChat's settings, then press "Try again". If it still doesn't show, use an image from another site.
tablet.image.error.invalidUrl: The URL isn't valid. Enter an image URL that starts with https://.
tablet.image.error.invalidImage: It can't be read as an image. Enter the URL of the image itself, not of a page (right-click the image in your browser and copy the image address). Unsupported formats and images larger than 2048 × 2048 can't be loaded either.
tablet.image.error.redirect: This URL redirects somewhere else, and VRChat doesn't follow redirects. Enter the URL of the image itself.
tablet.image.error.refused: This site doesn't let VRChat load its images. It may show in your browser, but not in VRChat. Use an image from another site.
tablet.image.error.notFound: The image wasn't found. Check that the URL is correct and the image hasn't been removed.
tablet.image.error.server: The site is busy or temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment, then press "Try again".
tablet.image.error.download: The image couldn't be downloaded. Check that the URL is correct, then press "Try again".
tablet.image.error.busy: Too many images are loading. Wait a moment, then press "Try again".
tablet.image.error.unknown: The cause is unknown. Press "Try again", or try another image.
tablet.image.listEmpty: Enter a URL, and the images you show will be listed here
